component.name: TextCraft
component.summary: A fast, modern text and Markdown editor

description.p: TextCraft is a fast, lightweight text and Markdown editor written in Rust with egui and wgpu. It features atomic file saves, multi-tab editing, session restore, robust character encoding detection, and a live rendered Markdown view.

ul.li: Atomic saves preventing accidental data loss
Markdown formatting toolbar, tables, and rendered side-by-side or preview view
Multi-tab workspace with inline file renaming and tab context actions
Advanced Find and Replace with regex and whole-word matching
Modern dark and light themes (Warm Paper & Pine-Slate)

screenshot.caption: TextCraft showing Markdown editing and live rendered view

description.p: Comprehensive UI/UX overhaul, workspace tab management, and Markdown formatting improvements.
